description: Where the text of each slide sits for every preset, so a generated plate keeps that part calm. Read by the visual-prompts skill when it writes a prompt card, and the source of the calm-zone declaration that the A1 backstop requires for every plate under text. Boxes are canvas pixels on the 1080x1440 design; 'start' and 'end' are logical (start is the right-hand side in Arabic).
derivedFrom: Each preset's variant list and the text anchoring of the archetype layouts (templates/archetypes.html). If a preset or a layout changes, regenerate this file; the preset wins over any row here.
howToUse: Take presets.<preset>.<slide type>. If the slide's variant is listed under 'variants', use that row's zone and coverage; otherwise use the row itself. Store 'zone' in slide.media.calmZone.

fields.zone: value stored in slide.media.calmZone: top, bottom, start, end, center or none
fields.coverage: share of the canvas along the zone's axis that must stay calm (top and bottom: of the height; center: height of a centred band, 1.0 = the whole frame; start and end: of the width)
fields.use: texture = tonal texture only, no subject; scene = a subject lives outside the calm zone; slot = fills a media slot with no text on it
fields.scrim: none, or soft (the engine may add a light ink-tinted gradient under the text)
fields.subject: where the plate's interest should be: top, bottom, edges or none
fields.defaultVariant: the preset's default variant for this slide type

top.phrase: the upper 55% of the frame is calm, low-detail negative space (a smooth tonal gradient, no objects, no high-contrast edges); the subject sits in the lower part

bottom.phrase: the lower 55% of the frame is calm, low-detail negative space (a smooth tonal gradient, no objects, no high-contrast edges); the subject sits in the upper part

center.phrase: a central horizontal band, 60% of the height, is calm low-detail negative space; interest lives only near the top and bottom edges

start.phrase: the start 50% of the width is calm low-detail negative space; the subject sits on the opposite side (for Arabic posts the start side is the right-hand side)

end.phrase: the end 50% of the width is calm low-detail negative space; the subject sits on the opposite side (for Arabic posts the start side is the right-hand side)

none.meaning: the plate fills a media slot and no text sits on it; no calm zone is needed

swiss._note: typographic preset: a plate is only a flat tonal texture behind the whole slide, never a subject
swiss._variants: default variant of each type = first entry of the preset's own variant list
